root_cause.issue: S19_BOUNDARY_PROTOCOL was not handled in the phase-specific config-building block that propagates frozen training budget fields (max_epochs, patience, min_delta, gradient_clip_enabled, gradient_clip_max_norm, seed) into the base dict. The _prepared_condition_base() function extracts only 14 fields, excluding the 6 training budget fields. For S9-S15, these are populated from source_run config. For S16-S18, they are handled by phase-specific blocks. S19 had no such block, so training budget fields were None/omitted, causing config['training']['max_epochs'] = None which triggered registry validation failure.

fix.description: Added S19_BOUNDARY_PROTOCOL handling block after S18_REVIN block to inherit max_epochs, patience, min_delta, gradient_clipping_enabled, gradient_clip_max_norm, and seed from the Phase 40 frozen configuration.
